all_badges.name: Quay Sovereign
all_badges.desc: Retained the #1 rank on the leaderboard continuously for > 72 hours
all_badges.criteria: Continuous tenure at Rank #1 exceeding 72 hours on official scoreboard.

all_badges.name: Speed Demon
all_badges.desc: Fastest elapsed time on a fully completed course without collision
all_badges.criteria: Minimum simulation time among all non-colliding course completions.

all_badges.name: Sea Turtle
all_badges.desc: Most cautious and slowest navigation completing the full course
all_badges.criteria: Maximum simulation time on fully cleared course without timing out.

all_badges.name: Sniper
all_badges.desc: All 7 capsules cleared with standoff < 50 cm (100% precision)
all_badges.criteria: 100% precision score on all 7 interactive capsules ($d_{\min} \le 0.50\text{ m}$).

all_badges.name: Watt Miser
all_badges.desc: Lowest cumulative thruster energy expenditure on a validated run
all_badges.criteria: Minimum integral of absolute thruster forces $\int (|T_L| + |T_R|) dt$ on completion.

all_badges.name: Sonar Whisperer
all_badges.desc: Maintained Ping2 lateral wall distance strictly within 5.0 ± 0.15 m across the Pier Corridor
all_badges.criteria: Standoff error $\le 0.15\text{ m}$ from the $5.0\text{ m}$ setpoint across $X \in [55, 85\text{ m}]$.

all_badges.name: Poseidon's Chosen
all_badges.desc: Completed course under severe procedural sea state (current ≥ 0.65 m/s, battery wear ≤ 0.90)
all_badges.criteria: Course completed with seed current $\ge 0.65\text{ m/s}$ and battery factor $\le 0.90$.

all_badges.name: Minimalist
all_badges.desc: Course cleared with the fewest total evaluation attempts
all_badges.criteria: Lowest total evaluation attempts among completed teams.

all_badges.name: Kraken's Grip
all_badges.desc: Survived extreme vortex currents (accumulated ≥ 720° yaw rotation while clearing waypoints)
all_badges.criteria: Total yaw change $|\Delta \psi| \ge 720^\circ$ during run while clearing waypoints.

all_badges.name: Siren's Call
all_badges.desc: Skimmed within < 1.5 m of the Cardinal mark during safe rounding without colliding
all_badges.criteria: Passing distance to cardinal buoy $< 1.5\text{ m}$ on regulatory side without contact.

all_badges.name: Navigator
all_badges.desc: Compliant IALA cardinal buoy rounding on regulatory side
all_badges.criteria: Rounded IALA cardinal mark on regulatory safe quadrant within $10.0\text{ m}$.

all_badges.name: Drift Master
all_badges.desc: Maintained pier corridor standoff without critical drift
all_badges.criteria: Corridor distance kept strictly between $1.0\text{ m}$ and $8.0\text{ m}$ ($X \in [35, 95\text{ m}]$).

all_badges.name: Edge of Glory
all_badges.desc: Skimmed within 1.01 m to 1.15 m of the pier wall without triggering critical contact
all_badges.criteria: Closest approach to quay wall between $1.01\text{ m}$ and $1.15\text{ m}$ without contact.

all_badges.name: Lead Foot
all_badges.desc: Maintained thrusters clamped at 100% saturation (±50 N) for > 85% of the run
all_badges.criteria: Motor thrust clamped at $\pm 50.0\text{ N}$ for $\ge 85\%$ of total run time.

all_badges.name: Crab Walk
all_badges.desc: Cleared a channel gate or leg while navigating in reverse
all_badges.criteria: Gate traversal with reverse surge velocity ($v_x < -0.2\text{ m/s}$).

all_badges.name: Donut King
all_badges.desc: Completed > 3 consecutive rotations in place (> 1080°) without linear forward progress
all_badges.criteria: Three continuous in-place rotations ($|\Delta \psi| \ge 1080^\circ$) with displacement $< 2\text{ m}$.

all_badges.name: PID Tremors
all_badges.desc: Thruster command sign reversed > 120 times in under 30 seconds (high-frequency chattering)
all_badges.criteria: Thruster command sign reversals exceeding 120 cycles within a 30-second window.

all_badges.name: Tis But a Scratch
all_badges.desc: Scored > 1500 pts on the immediate next submission following a fatal collision
all_badges.criteria: Successful completion ($> 1500\text{ pts}$) immediately after a COLLISION run.

all_badges.name: Espresso Powered
all_badges.desc: Submitted ≥ 5 evaluation runs within a rolling 6-hour window
all_badges.criteria: Submission frequency $\ge 5$ runs recorded within 6 consecutive hours.

all_badges.name: Dawn Patrol
all_badges.desc: Submission evaluated at dawn between 05:00 and 07:30 UTC
all_badges.criteria: Run evaluated between 05:00 and 07:30 UTC.

all_badges.name: Night Owl
all_badges.desc: Submission evaluated between 23:00 and 04:00 UTC
all_badges.criteria: Run evaluated between 23:00 and 04:00 UTC.

all_badges.name: Titanic
all_badges.desc: First spectacular collision with the pier wall
all_badges.criteria: Hull contact registered with quay or pier structure.

all_badges.name: Davy Jones' Locker
all_badges.desc: Run terminated, collided, or timed out before clearing Gate 1 (X < 12 m)
all_badges.criteria: Simulation aborted or failed before clearing Gate 1 ($X < 12.0\text{ m}$).
